cues: The white curve is one over one minus x.
The yellow curve adds up the series term by term.
Inside the green band, where x is between minus one and one, the partial sums close in on the true curve.
Outside it, they fly away, no matter how many terms you take.
text: Watch why. The white curve is one over one minus x. The yellow curve adds up the series term by term. Inside the green band, where x is between minus one and one, the partial sums close in on the true curve. Outside it, they fly away, no matter how many terms you take.
